ns2:course.label: Graduate Independent Study
ns2:course.description: Independent research project or thesis topic development to be supervised by Geography & GIS faculty advisor. May be repeated in separate semesters. After passing the Preliminary Exam, PhD candidates should register for GGIS 599: Thesis Research instead of this course.
